name: Bioethics
notes: Prerequisites of individual courses are not counted toward the major.
Students may major, minor, OR complete a cluster within the public health-related programs, but not more than one.
No more than two courses may overlap between a public health major and another major.
STAT 212 was valid until spring 2024; STAT 180 is the current course.
Several electives carry validity windows or class-year restrictions noted on the department page.
The major requires BOTH PHIL 228 and PHIL 225: one counts toward the Public Health General Core and the other toward the Specific Core Requirements.

NEEDS VERIFICATION: the four electives are split into themes (Philosophy and Ethics, 2 courses, plus further themes); only the first theme was captured in the page snapshot, so the remaining two electives are modeled as PHLT/PHIL courses.

requirementGroups.label: Public health general core
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Public Health General Core (Four Courses): PHLT 101: Introduction to Public Health I; PHLT 103: Concepts of Epidemiology

requirementGroups.label: Statistics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: STAT 212: Applied Statistics I (valid until spring 2024) or STAT 180: Introduction to Applied Statistical Methodology (valid beginning fall 2024)

requirementGroups.label: Public health or medical ethics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 228 (PHIL 228W): Public Health Ethics or PHIL 225: Ethical Decisions in Medicine

requirementGroups.label: Introductory ethics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 102: General Ethics or PHIL 103: Contemporary Moral Problems

requirementGroups.label: Health law and policy
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHLT/PSCI 236: Health Care and Law or PHLT 230: Public Health Law and Policy

requirementGroups.label: Second ethics course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 228/228W: Public Health Ethics or PHIL 225/225W: Ethical Decisions in Medicine
requirementGroups.note: The major requires both PHIL 228 and PHIL 225; the other one counts in the general core.

requirementGroups.label: Philosophy and ethics electives (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: I. Philosophy and Ethics (2 Courses). Choose two of the following: MHB 210: Bioethics at the Bedside; MHB 410U: Clinical Bioethics; MHB 472U: Philosophical Foundations of Bioethics; PHIL 102: General Ethics; PHIL 103: Contemporary Moral Problems

requirementGroups.label: Further electives (2)
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS VERIFICATION - the later elective themes were truncated in the captured page.

upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: PHLT 300W (H): Seminar for Bioethics Majors; PHIL 223/223W; PHIL 228/228W; PHIL 225/225W
